description.html: The three-tower castle is a more colorful aquarium decoration: three towers of different heights have reddish conical roofs, and the walls are sand-colored with stone details and green traces of moss. Stairs lead up to the towers, and there are passages and openings at the base of the castle.

Fish swim in and out through the openings at the base and in the towers, so the castle also serves as a hiding place. The red roofs add a warm accent to the aquarium and stand out nicely against a green background of plants. This castle is a favorite in kids' and themed aquariums, and it also combines well with the other castles in our range when you want a whole underwater kingdom.

Before placing it, rinse the castle in lukewarm water, without soap. Set it on a flat bottom and press it lightly into the substrate so it stands firmly, with the passages facing the front glass. Make sure the openings are large enough for the fish you keep. During regular maintenance, remove algae with a soft brush and rinse debris out of the inside.
